question: India's First Five Year Plan covered the period from ______, which mainly focused in the development of the primary sector.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951 to 1956**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1951 to 1956** marks the period of **India's First Five Year Plan**.
 
• The First Five Year Plan was primarily focused on the **development of the primary sector**, which includes agriculture, irrigation, and power.
 
• The plan aimed to improve the living standards of the peop
